notes.title: Notice of 'Trilogy of the Moon' New Language Pack 2nd Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hello,
This is the Skyplus team of 'Trilogy of the Moon'[/h2]

We sincerely thank you for your love and interest in 'Trilogy of the Moon', and we are pleased to inform you that the second new language pack update has been completed.

[b]Second Language Pack Update Details[/b]
• French (French / Français)
• Spanish (Spanish / Español)
• Russian (Russian / Русский)

📅 Update Schedule
May 26, 2025 (Monday) 1:00 PM (KST) update

We hope that through the language pack update, more global users will be able to immerse themselves naturally and enjoy this work.

The Skyplus team will continue to expand support for various languages and do our best to provide you with a richer gaming experience.

Thank you for your continued interest and support.
Thank you.

notes.title: 《Trilogy of the Moon》 New Language Pack 2nd Update Notice
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, this is the Skyplus team of 《Trilogy of the Moon》.[/h2]

[h3]We sincerely thank you for your love and interest in 《Trilogy of the Moon》,
and we would like to announce the 2nd update of our new language packs.[/h3]

In the upcoming May 2025, the following 3 languages will be added to 《Trilogy of the Moon》:

[b]• French (French / Français)
• Spanish (Spanish / Español)
• Russian (Russian / Русский)[/b]

We hope this update will allow more global users to naturally immerse themselves in and enjoy this work.

The Skyplus team will continue to strive to provide a richer gaming experience 
through expanded language support.

We look forward to your continued support and interest.
Thank you.

notes.title: New Language Pack Update for Trilogy of the Moon Completed
notes.content:
[h2]Hello,
This is the Skyplus Team of Trilogy of the Moon.[/h2]

Thanks to your continued support, we are pleased to announce that the new language pack update has been successfully completed.

[h3]This update adds the following three languages:[/h3]
[b]German (Deutsch)
Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia)
Thai (ภาษาไทย)[/b]

📌 Applicable Versions
Full Version
Demo Version

Now, more global users can enjoy Trilogy of the Moon in their preferred language.

Future language updates are planned, and we will inform you as soon as more information becomes available.

The Skyplus Team will continue to work hard to provide a richer gaming experience by expanding language support and improving content quality.

Thank you for your continued support.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/0a1321aafe729d5f805a43dabaf3c6a6445d01db.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 📢 April 15th Trilogy of the Moon Major Bug Fix Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Skyplus team.

Thank you for playing 《Trilogy of the Moon》.
We have identified some issues where certain features in the game were not functioning properly, and have applied the following patches:

🔧 Bug Fixes
1. Fixed the issue where the screen appears cut off at certain resolutions
2. Fixed the issue where the main screen background music volume could not be adjusted

We will continue to do our best to provide you with a comfortable playing environment.
If you have any inconveniences or suggestions while playing, please feel free to leave your feedback through the Steam discussion board.
We will listen to your feedback and strive to take prompt action.

Thank you.
From the Skyplus Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/4261a0e2efae6f0597ef718561cdecfcdaa58460.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 📢 April 11 – Trilogy of the Moon – Major Bug Fixes Announcement
notes.content:
Hello, this is the Skyplus Team.

Thank you for playing Trilogy of the Moon.
We’ve identified some issues where certain features were not functioning correctly and have applied a patch with the following fixes:

🔧 Bug Fixes:
1. Fixed an issue where some achievements could not be completed properly
2. Adjusted the default brightness setting

We will continue doing our best to provide a smooth and enjoyable gaming experience.
If you encounter any problems or have suggestions, please feel free to share them via the Steam Discussion Board.
We’re listening to your feedback and will work quickly to respond.

Thank you,
Skyplus Team

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470356/8088663b4c62fb274b35953f7f6f12b3f3b478a2.jpg[/img]
